partners.mechanism_chain: GAMT (HGNC:4031) —DECREASES→ Guanidinoacetate (CHEBI:17240); Guanidinoacetate (CHEBI:17240) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); PTEN (HGNC:9588) —DISRUPTS→ PI3K-Akt signaling pathway (WP:WP1076); AKT1 (HGNC:425) —INCREASES→ PI3K-Akt signaling pathway (WP:WP1076); PI3K-Akt signaling pathway (WP:WP1076) —LEADS_TO→ Macrocephaly (HP:0000252); PI3K-Akt signaling pathway (WP:WP1076) —LEADS_TO→ Hamartoma (HP:0002677). Loss-of-function mutations in GAMT lead to decreased production of guanidinoacetate, contributing to intellectual disability in MONDO:0012999. Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in PTEN and/or gain-of-function mutations in AKT1 dysregulate the PI3K-Akt signaling pathway, leading to phenotypes like macrocephaly and hamartomas in PTEN hamartoma tumor syndrome.
